# Freesound

Kenney RPG Audio has no wildlife loops. This folder was going to hold CC0 Freesound clips (seagulls, tropical birds, pig, splash).

Freesound’s API needs a logged-in token, so clips were **not** downloaded. Island fauna one-shots are original procedural buffers in `web/src/audio.ts` (same approach as the existing frogs). Keep this directory so a later pass can drop CC0 files here without inventing a new layout.
